name: Seated Back Extension Machine
instructions: Set the back pad so it sits across your upper back and adjust the seat so your hips line up with the machine's pivot.
Sit with your feet flat and fasten the lap belt if the machine has one. Sit tall against the pad. This is your starting position.
Press backwards by extending through the spine and hips until your torso is roughly in line with your thighs. Move smoothly; do not throw yourself into the pad.
Return under control to upright, letting the weight stack come close to the rest without touching it.
Distinct from the 45-degree hyperextension bench: your bodyweight is supported here and the load is set on a stack, which makes it easier to start light and progress in small steps.
